name: close-end-to-end
title: the owner verifies the end itself after the units and lands delivered + pendingClose
label: v2 AC-9 (3)
description: Mission v2 §3.5 / AC-9 (3). A scripted setup gives the owner A an active mission with one unit whose step links the child session C that built it. Then A, as an owner reading the shipped `mission` skill, is told it checked the unit's evidence (every AC met) and the end's evidence exists, and is asked to finish. The skill's `mission done` flow: record the unit's verdict, verify the fixed end itself (its builders are every step's linked sessions; the owner built none, so it lands `verified`), read `closeReadiness`, and call `mission_request_close`. Graded from the mission file: the unit and the end are `verified` by A, and the mission is `delivered` with `pendingClose` — the close itself stays the operator's.

phases.prompt:
1. mcp__harnu__mission_create with folder="{{folder}}", title="Search box", sessionId="{{self}}", declaredEnd={"kind":"code","target":"PR #3 (search box) merged into main","evidence":"PR #3 merged with green CI and every AC verified"}.
2. mcp__harnu__mission_add_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=<missionId from step 1>, title="Unit 1 — search box", verification="verifier".
3. mcp__harnu__mission_link_child with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=<missionId from step 1>, stepId=<stepId from step 2>, link={"kind":"session","ref":"{{session.C}}"}.

Skill file: .eval/mission-SKILL.md. Your mission is {{m.search-box.id}}.

Where things stand: the only unit, "Unit 1 — search box", was built by session {{session.C}} (already linked to its step). You checked its evidence yourself — the diff, the green tests, all 4 ACs met — and have not recorded that verdict yet. PR #3 is merged into main with green CI, which is exactly the end's evidence. Nothing else is left in this delivery. Finish the mission, as the skill's section "`mission done`" says.

assert.label: the unit is verified by the owner (C built it)
the fixed end is verified, not self-verified
the owner verified the end itself
the close was requested: pendingClose by the owner
